swap.title: The contraction
swap.code:
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    var acc'0: f32 = -0.0
    for k in 0 .. K do
      acc'0 = fma (load a[i, k]) (load b[k, j]) acc'0
    store c[i, j] = acc'0

swap.title: zero (i, j) c
swap.code:
for zi in 0 .. M do for zj in 0 .. N do
  store c[zi, zj] = -0.0
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    for k in 0 .. K do
      let acc'0 = load c[i, j]
      store c[i, j] = fma ... acc'0

swap.title: hoist (j, k) c
swap.code:
for zi in 0 .. M do for zj in 0 .. N do
  store c[zi, zj] = -0.0
for i in 0 .. M do
  for k in 0 .. K do
    for j in 0 .. N do
      let acc'0 = load c[i, j]
      store c[i, j] = fma ... acc'0

rows.title: The contraction
rows.code:
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    var acc'0: f32 = -0.0
    for k in 0 .. K do
      acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
    store c[i, j] = acc'0

rows.title: grid over (i, j)
rows.code:
grid on M4Gpu i in 0 .. M, j in 0 .. N
    writes c[i, j] as ct do
  ... // the same running total and k loop
  store ct = acc'0

tiled.title: The contraction
tiled.code:
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    var acc'0: f32 = -0.0
    for k in 0 .. K do
      acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
    store c[i, j] = acc'0

tiled.title: grid over (i, j)
tiled.code:
grid on M4Gpu i in 0 .. M, j in 0 .. N writes c[i, j] as ct do
  var acc'0: f32 = -0.0
  for k in 0 .. K do
    acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
  store ct = acc'0

tiled.title: tiles (i, j, k) (16, 16) (8, 8)
tiled.code:
grid on M4Gpu gi in 0 .. M / 16, gj in 0 .. N / 16
    by tile (si, sj) parts [8, 8]
    writes c[...] as ct_2 do
  var t: [f32; 16, 16] = repeat (-0.0)
  for k in 0 .. K / 8 do
    let x: [f32; 16, 8] = load a[...]
    let y: [f32; 8, 16] = load b[...]
    t = mma x y t
  store ct_2 = t

tower.title: The contraction
tower.code:
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    var acc'0: S.Value = S.zero ()
    for k in 0 .. K do
      acc'0 = S.mul_add ... acc'0
    store c[i, j] = acc'0

tower.title: zero (i, j) c
tower.code:
for zi in 0 .. M do for zj in 0 .. N do
  store c[zi, zj] = S.zero ()
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    for k in 0 .. K do
      let acc'0 = load c[i, j]
      store c[i, j] = S.mul_add ... acc'0

tower.title: split k by 16 as gk ragged
tower.code:
... // zero C
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
      for k in 0 .. gk.len do
        let acc'0 = load c[i, j]
        store c[i, j] = S.mul_add ... acc'0

tower.title: split i by 16 as gi, 4 as ui ragged
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
  for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
    for i in 0 .. ui.len do
      for j in 0 .. N do
        for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
          for k in 0 .. gk.len do
            let acc'0 = load c[gi[ui[i]], j]
            store c[gi[ui[i]], j] = S.mul_add ... acc'0

tower.title: split j by 8 as gj ragged
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
  for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
    for i in 0 .. ui.len do
      for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
        for j in 0 .. gj.len do
          for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
            for k in 0 .. gk.len do
              let acc'0 = load c[gi[ui[i]], gj[j]]
              store c[gi[ui[i]], gj[j]] = S.mul_add ... acc'0

tower.title: order (gk, gj, gi, ui, i, j)
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
      for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
        for i in 0 .. ui.len do
          for j in 0 .. gj.len do
            for k in 0 .. gk.len do
              let acc'0 = load c[gi[ui[i]], gj[j]]
              store c[gi[ui[i]], gj[j]] = S.mul_add ... acc'0

tower.title: pack a into packA along gi over (a0, a1)
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
      for a0 in 0 .. gi.len do
        for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
          store packA[a0, a1] = load a[gi[a0], gk[a1]]
      ... // update C from packA and B

tower.title: keep packA along gi within L2 into packA_L2
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
      for a0 in 0 .. gi.len do
        for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
          store packA[a0, a1] = load a[gi[a0], gk[a1]]
      lease mut packA_L2 = packA at L2
      ... // update C from packA_L2 and B

tower.title: pack b into packB along gj over (b0, b1)
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
    for b0 in 0 .. gk.len do
      for b1 in 0 .. gj.len do
        store packB[b0, b1] = load b[gk[b0], gj[b1]]
    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
      for a0 in 0 .. gi.len do
        for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
          store packA[a0, a1] = load a[gi[a0], gk[a1]]
      lease mut packA_L2 = packA at L2
      ... // update C from packA_L2 and packB

tower.title: keep packB along gj within L1 into packB_L1
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
    for b0 in 0 .. gk.len do
      for b1 in 0 .. gj.len do
        store packB[b0, b1] = load b[gk[b0], gj[b1]]
    lease mut packB_L1 = packB at L1
    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
      for a0 in 0 .. gi.len do
        for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
          store packA[a0, a1] = load a[gi[a0], gk[a1]]
      lease mut packA_L2 = packA at L2
      ... // update C from packA_L2 and packB_L1

tower.title: registers (i, j) into c rows 4 lanes 8 through fma
tower.code:
... // zero C
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
    ... // pack B and keep it at L1
    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
      ... // pack A and keep it at L2
      for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
        var acc'0: [Vec f32 8; 4] = ...
        ... // load the current totals from C into acc'0
        for k in 0 .. gk.len do
          let lanes: Vec f32 8 = load packB_L1[...] ...
          for i in 0 .. ui.len do
            let row: Vec f32 8 = splat (load packA_L2[...])
            acc'0[i] = fma row lanes acc'0[i]
        ... // store acc'0 back to C

fast.title: packed
fast.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 16 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
    ... // pack B and keep it at L1
    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 16 do
      ... // pack A and keep it at L2
      for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
        var acc'0: [Vec f32 8; 4] = ...
        ... // load C, accumulate across k, and store C

fast.title: Larger blocks
fast.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 256 do
  for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do

    for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 512 do
      ... // pack A and keep it at L2
      for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
        var acc'0: [Vec f32 8; 4] = ...
        ... // load C, accumulate across k, and store C

fast.title: Rows first
fast.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 256 do

    for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 8 do
      ... // pack B and keep it at L1
      for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
        var acc'0: [Vec f32 8; 4] = ...
        ... // load C, accumulate across k, and store C

fast.title: A wider tile
fast.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 256 do
  for gi in blocks (0 .. M) 512 do
    ... // pack A and keep it at L2
    for gj in blocks (0 .. N) 16 do
      ... // pack B and keep it at L1
      for ui in blocks (0 .. gi.len) 4 do
        var acc'0: [Vec f32 16; 4] = ...
        ... // load C, accumulate across k, and store C

sme.title: The contraction
sme.code:
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    var acc'0: f64 = -0.0
    for k in 0 .. K do
      acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
    store c[i, j] = acc'0

sme.title: split k by 3072 as gk ragged
sme.code:
for i in 0 .. M do
  for j in 0 .. N do
    for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
      var acc'0: f64 = if gk.lo == 0 then -0.0 else load c[i, j]
      for k in 0 .. gk.len do
        acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
      store c[i, j] = acc'0

sme.title: split j by 256 as gj, 16 as uj
sme.code:
for i in 0 .. M do
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    for uj in blocks (0 .. 256) 16 do
      for j in 0 .. uj.len do
        for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
          var acc'0: f64 = if gk.lo == 0 then -0.0 else load c[...]
          for k in 0 .. gk.len do
            acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
          store c[...] = acc'0

sme.title: split i by 1536 as gi, 32 as ui
sme.code:
for gi in 0 .. M / 1536 do
  for ui in blocks (0 .. 1536) 32 do
    for i in 0 .. ui.len do
      for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
        for uj in blocks (0 .. 256) 16 do
          for j in 0 .. uj.len do
            for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
              var acc'0: f64 = if gk.lo == 0 then -0.0 else load c[...]
              for k in 0 .. gk.len do
                acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
              store c[...] = acc'0

sme.title: order (gk, gj, gi, ui, uj, i, j)
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    for gi in 0 .. M / 1536 do
      for ui in blocks (0 .. 1536) 32 do
        for uj in blocks (0 .. 256) 16 do
          for i in 0 .. ui.len do
            for j in 0 .. uj.len do
              var acc'0: f64 = if gk.lo == 0 then -0.0 else load c[...]
              for k in 0 .. gk.len do
                acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
              store c[...] = acc'0

sme.title: parallel gi
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      for ui in blocks (0 .. 1536) 32 do
        for uj in blocks (0 .. 256) 16 do
          for i in 0 .. ui.len do
            for j in 0 .. uj.len do
              var acc'0: f64 = if gk.lo == 0 then -0.0 else load c[...]
              for k in 0 .. gk.len do
                acc'0 = fma ... acc'0
              store c[...] = acc'0

sme.title: pack a into packA along gk over (a0, a1)
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  for a0 in 0 .. M do
    for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
      store packA[a0, a1] = load a[a0, gk[a1]]
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      ... // update C from packA and B

sme.title: strip a0 32 (pa, ra)
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  for pa in 0 .. M / 32 do
    for ra in 0 .. 32 do
      for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
        store packA[0 + pa * 32 + ra, a1] = load a[...]
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      ... // update C from packA and B

sme.title: parallel pa
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  grid pa in 0 .. M / 32 writes packA[...] do
    for ra in 0 .. 32 do
      for a1 in 0 .. gk.len do
        store packA[0 + pa * 32 + ra, a1] = load a[...]
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      ... // update C from packA and B

sme.title: pack b into packB along gj over (b0, b1)
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  grid pa in 0 .. M / 32 writes packA[...] do
    ... // pack A
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    for b0 in 0 .. gk.len do
      for b1 in 0 .. 256 do
        store packB[b0, b1] = load b[gk[b0], gj * 256 + b1]
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      ... // update C from packA and packB

sme.title: strip b1 16 (pb, rb)
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  grid pa in 0 .. M / 32 writes packA[...] do
    ... // pack A
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    for b0 in 0 .. gk.len do
      for pb in 0 .. 256 / 16 do
        for rb in 0 .. 16 do
          store packB[b0, 0 + pb * 16 + rb] = load b[...]
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      ... // update C from packA and packB

sme.title: interchange (b0, pb)
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  grid pa in 0 .. M / 32 writes packA[...] do
    ... // pack A
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    for pb in 0 .. 16 do
      for b0 in 0 .. gk.len do
        for rb in 0 .. 16 do
          store packB[b0, 0 + pb * 16 + rb] = load b[...]
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      ... // update C from packA and packB

sme.title: parallel pb
sme.code:
for gk in blocks (0 .. K) 3072 do
  grid pa in 0 .. M / 32 writes packA[...] do
    ... // pack A
  for gj in 0 .. N / 256 do
    grid pb in 0 .. 16 writes packB[...] do
      for b0 in 0 .. gk.len do
        for rb in 0 .. 16 do
          store packB[b0, 0 + pb * 16 + rb] = load b[...]
    grid gi in 0 .. M / 1536
        writes c[...] do
      ... // update C from packA and packB

sme.title: registers (i, j) into c rows 32 lanes 16 through fma
sme.code:
... // pack inputs, and distribute the output bands
for ui in blocks (0 .. 1536) 32 do
  for uj in blocks (0 .. 256) 16 do
    var acc'0: [Vec f64 16; 32] = ...
    ... // the 32 × 16 output tile: −0.0 on the first block, else c's
    for k in 0 .. gk.len do
      let lanes: Vec f64 16 = ...
      for i in 0 .. ui.len do
        let row: Vec f64 16 = ...
        acc'0[i] = fma row lanes acc'0[i]
    ... // store the output tile

sme.title: outer_products i c 8 8 outer_fma_primitive
sme.code:
... // pack inputs, and distribute the output bands
for ui in blocks (0 .. 1536) 32 do
  for uj in blocks (0 .. 256) 16 do
    var blocks_2: [Vec f64 (8 * 8); 4 * 2] = ...
    ... // the same tile as eight 8 × 8 blocks: −0.0, else c's
    for k in 0 .. gk.len do
      ... // row and column masks
      let column_all: Vec f64 32 = load packA[...]
      let row_all: Vec f64 16 = load packB[...]
      for q in 0 .. ui.len / 8 * 2 do
        let column = slice_lanes column_all (floor (q / 2) * 8)
        let row = slice_lanes row_all (q % 2 * 8)
        blocks_2[q] =
          outer_fma_primitive column row blocks_2[q] rows cols
    ... // store the eight blocks

flash.title: The contraction
flash.code:
for i in 0 .. 64 do
  for d in 0 .. 16 do
    var acc'1: Online.Value = Online.empty ()
    for j in 0 .. 32 do
      ... // compute this key's score in acc'0
      acc'1 = Online.combine acc'1 (key acc'0 (load v[j, d]))
    store y[i, d] = normalised acc'1

flash.title: The schedule
flash.code:
grid on M4Gpu gi in 0 .. 2
    by tile (si, sj) parts [8, 16]
    writes y[...] as yt do
  ... // initialise the running summary: m, l and o
  for gj in 0 .. 4 do
    ... // compute a 32 × 8 score tile s with mma
    let m2 = max m (reduce Max f32 over cols by halving do s)
    let e = exp (s - m2)
    let alpha = rescale m m2
    l = l * alpha + (reduce Sum f32 over cols by order do e)
    let w: [f32; 8, 16] = load v[...]
    o = o * alpha
    o = mma e w o
    m = m2
  store yt = o / l
